subject.title: [Feature]: Channel Broker Phase 2A - broker conformance harness

question: Should OpenClaw approve a separate Channel Broker SDK/bundled-plugin conformance boundary, or keep extending the existing `channel-outbound` contracts for these lifecycle guarantees?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested broker surface, and the prior implementation stack was closed because the SDK, runtime, config, and security boundaries need maintainer-approved design before code of this scope resumes.

options.title: Require a smaller design proposal first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the narrow tracker, but require a maintainer-approved broker/API design before any implementation PR starts.

options.title: Extend channel-outbound instead
options.body: Reject a separate broker layer for now and track any missing conformance coverage against the existing native channel message lifecycle contract.

options.title: Approve a broker harness boundary
options.body: Sponsor a focused broker SDK/plugin conformance harness with explicit config, security, migration, and major-channel rollout limits.

recommendation.title: Require a smaller design proposal first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the narrow tracker, but require a maintainer-approved broker/API design before any implementation PR starts.
